recipe.title: Creamy chicken pasta with spinach
steps: Cook the pasta until al dente, drain and let it cool a little.
Cut the chicken into small pieces and brown it in a non-stick pan with the garlic, salt and pepper.
Add the broth and the light cream cheese. Stir until the sauce is smooth.
Add the spinach and the nutmeg and cook until the spinach wilts.
Mix with the pasta, split into 4 containers and store in the fridge. Reheat in the microwave.
